content.name: Midnight's Terran Research
content.description: Player HQ research is paid along the Terran production ladder instead of in Commonwealth wares: energy cells, ore, silicon and nividium, metallic microlattice, silicon carbide and computronic substrate. Every cost keeps its original credit value at average ware prices (within 1%), and the more valuable the research, the more of it is paid in higher-tier Terran wares. Requires the Cradle of Humanity DLC. Covers the base game, the Envoy Pack, Tides of Avarice and Timelines DLCs.
content.author: Midnight
